hypothesis: Strictly prior same-PA family adds incremental prediction information beyond known current action type after TRAIN-only shrinkage selection and exact no-history fallback
baseline: HierarchicalFrequencyBaseline(include_pitcher=False), global add1/count50/type50; fit identical selected TRAIN rows
feature: previous_family mapped exactly as EXP-B-PAHISTORY-001; no current delivery or result
no_history_rule: NONE and unseen context must return parent probabilities exactly; never fit a separate NONE table
mixture: (1-alpha)*parent + alpha*context; common impossible-DP conditioning before scoring
selection: Minimum pooled pitch-weighted forward-validation NLL; ties within 1e-10 choose smaller alpha. Adopt nonzero alpha only if pooled delta<0 AND delta<=0 separately in BOTH validation blocks; otherwise alpha=0.
fold_integrity: max(fit game date)<min(validation game date); complete PA boundaries and same rows/actions/labels for all alphas; fold parents fitted only on fold fit rows
after_selection: Commit selected alpha, full forward scores, source/config/data hashes and final TRAIN checkpoint identity BEFORE any DEV prediction
alpha_zero_rule: If alpha=0, record TRAIN gate rejection and no new DEV model comparison; baseline exact-equivalence check suffices
dev_if_nonzero: One evaluation on the unchanged exposed July2025 DEV; all and two_strikes NLL/Brier/ECE, per-game paired CI, support/fallback. Never refit or select using DEV.
maximum_fits: 2 forward folds x 1 fixed parent+context table; 1 final full TRAIN fit. No neural fitting, temperature search, or sample expansion.
adoption: Prediction screening only; known-type conditional score is not policy improvement. No service/target recommendation update from this experiment.
exposure: All existing April/July aggregate and diagnostic results were known when designed; this is a prospective rule for the next exploratory run, not independent confirmation.
